notes.help_text:
📝 *UMARNIN BAYANI*

*Ƙara bayani:*
{{prefix}}addnote <rubutu>
{{prefix}}newnote <rubutu>
{{prefix}}makenote <rubutu>

*Samun takamaiman bayani:*
{{prefix}}getnote <lamba>
{{prefix}}listnote <lamba>

*Samun duk bayanan ka:*
{{prefix}}getnotes
{{prefix}}getallnotes
{{prefix}}listnotes

*Sabunta bayani:*
{{prefix}}updatenote <lamba> <sabon rubutu>

*Share takamaiman bayani:*
{{prefix}}delnote <lamba>
{{prefix}}deletenote <lamba>
{{prefix}}removenote <lamba>

*Share duk bayanan ka:*
{{prefix}}delallnotes
{{prefix}}removeallnotes
{{prefix}}deleteallnotes

_Bayanai na sirri ne kuma ana ajiye su lafiya a database._

settings.antiedit_options:
❌ Da fatan za a zaɓa: *on*, *off*, *indm* (DM kawai), ko *inchat* (hira kawai)

*Dabi'un halal na yanzu:*
• *indm* - Faɗakarwa a DM na mai shi kawai (tsoho)
• *inchat* - Faɗakarwa a wannan hira kawai
• *on* - Faɗakarwa a DM da hira
• *off* - Kashe anti-edit

• *.badwords clear* - Cire duk kalmomin batsa
• *.badwords default* - Loda kalmomin batsa na tsoho ({{defaultCount}})
